title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the functional student-preferred spaces at Baylor University, from quiet library gardens to active study commons and renovated historic lounges.

cards.title: The Garden Level Study Commons
cards.subtitle: Active Study Zone
cards.notes: Utilize the open-concept tables for group projects. The space features a makerspace and an enclosed outdoor garden with patio furniture and electrical outlets for laptop use.
cards.short_summary: A lively, collaborative study hub on the bottom floor of Moody Memorial Library featuring a makerspace and garden.
cards.evidence_claim: The Moody Garden Level is an active study zone with flexible furnishings for group work and includes a makerspace and access to the Gregory and Harvey Gardens.
cards.source_title: Study Zones in Moody and Jones | University Libraries, Museums, and the Press
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; check the library website for seasonal and 24-hour finals schedules.

cards.title: Garden of Contentment
cards.subtitle: Quiet Outdoor Retreat
cards.notes: Find a teak bench near the central fountain for a quiet reading session. This landscaped garden offers a serene atmosphere away from the central campus bustle.
cards.short_summary: A peaceful, landscaped garden adjacent to the Armstrong Browning Library featuring teak benches and a fountain.
cards.evidence_claim: The Garden of Contentment is a versatile outdoor gathering space and garden at Armstrong Browning Library with teak benches and a fountain.
cards.source_title: Baylor Dedicates Garden of Contentment at Armstrong Browning Library
cards.access_notes: Accessible during daylight hours; the library itself has specific public hours.

cards.title: The SUB Gameroom
cards.subtitle: Lower Level Social Hub
cards.notes: Head to the lower level of the Bill Daniel Student Center for bowling, billiards, and foosball. It is a primary spot for late-night student community building.
cards.short_summary: A student recreation center in the Bill Daniel Student Center featuring bowling lanes and table games.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baylor Gameroom is located on the lower level of the Bill Daniel Student Center and offers bowling, billiards, foosball, and shuffleboard.
cards.access_notes: Open weekdays 2pm-9pm during summer; extended hours during the academic year.

cards.title: Tidwell Graduate Lounge
cards.subtitle: Renovated Historic Space
cards.notes: Access this dedicated lounge in the newly renovated Tidwell building. It provides a quiet, modern environment for graduate students to focus between classes.
cards.short_summary: A modern, dedicated lounge for graduate students located within the historic Tidwell Bible Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The renovated Tidwell Bible Building includes a dedicated graduate student lounge as part of its 57,000 square feet of enhanced academic space.
cards.source_title: Tidwell Bible Building - Give Light - Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Restricted to graduate students; building open during academic hours.

cards.title: BSB Atrium
cards.subtitle: Collaborative Science Hub
cards.notes: Use the open seating in the three-story atrium for collaborative study. It is a high-energy space with nearby dining options for quick breaks.
cards.short_summary: A large, sunlit atrium in the Baylor Sciences Building used for individual and group study.
cards.evidence_claim: The BSB atrium is a common area for students and faculty that offers a productive atmosphere for individual study and group work.
cards.source_title: BaylorProud » 5 famous study spots on Baylor's campus
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; common areas cannot be reserved for private meetings.

cards.title: Poage Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Quiet Library Secret
cards.notes: Look for the angled floor-to-ceiling windows between Moody and Jones. This room is known for its serene atmosphere and is ideal for deep concentration.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, light-filled reading room located between the two main campus libraries.
cards.evidence_claim: The Poage Reading Room is described as a quiet, serene atmosphere for solo study, marked by its unique angled windows.
cards.source_title: BaylorProud » 7 scenic (and safe) study spots on Baylor's campus
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; typically follows standard library quiet zone rules.

cards.title: Vara Martin Daniel Plaza
cards.subtitle: Central Seating Area
cards.notes: Sit at the outdoor tables between the SUB and Carroll Science Hall. It is a popular spot for outdoor lunch breaks and student organization tabling.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor plaza with seating located in the heart of campus near the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: Vara Martin Daniel Plaza is an exterior lawn and seating space located between the Bill Daniel Student Center and Carroll Science Hall.
cards.source_title: Fountains, Namesakes and Rockets | Baylor Magazine
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as an outdoor campus space.

cards.title: Barfield Drawing Room
cards.subtitle: Traditional Lounge
cards.notes: Head to the second floor of the SUB for a classic study vibe. The room features traditional decor and comfortable couches for a living-room-style experience.
cards.short_summary: A traditionally decorated lounge on the second floor of the Bill Daniel Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Barfield Drawing Room is a scenic study spot on the second floor of the SUB known for its traditional decor and quiet nooks.
cards.source_title: BaylorProud » The 9 most beautiful study spots on Baylor's campus
cards.access_notes: Open during SUB operating hours; occasionally reserved for special events.

cards.title: Draper Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Historic Academic Nook
cards.notes: Find the courtyard tucked between Old Main and the Draper Academic Building. It is a shaded spot for students to pause between classes in the historic core.
cards.short_summary: A shaded outdoor courtyard located between the historic Old Main and Draper Academic Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The courtyard between Old Main and Draper is cited as one of the most beautiful study spots on campus.
cards.source_title: BaylorProud » The 9 most beautiful study spots on Baylor's campus
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as an outdoor campus space.

cards.entity_name: Jesse H. Jones Library First Floor
cards.title: Jones Library Study Area
cards.subtitle: Individual Study Zone
cards.notes: Venture to the first floor of Jones for a quieter, less crowded alternative to Moody. It houses the Crosshatch Art Gallery and specialized collections.
cards.short_summary: A quiet individual study area in the Jesse H. Jones Library, often less busy than the main library foyer.
cards.evidence_claim: Jones 1st Floor is designated as an individual study zone and includes a study area, the Crosshatch Art Gallery, and government documents.
cards.source_title: Map and Location Guide - Moody & Jones Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; check for specific floor access times.
